dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Perry County, Arkansas, and local residents using the conveyed property for educational or youth development purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Involves a single local property transfer of less than one acre subject to reversion conditions.
dimensions.evidence: consisting of approximately 0.81 acres of Forest Service land located at 1069 Fourche Avenue, Perryville, Arkansas

dimensions.assessment: Conveyance is made without federal consideration, with the county covering all survey, environmental, and historical analysis costs.
dimensions.evidence: made without consideration... the County shall pay all costs associated with the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: Applies a targeted, site-specific property transfer mandate to a single local government entity.
dimensions.evidence: The property referred to in subsection (a) is the parcel of real property... referred to as parcel 850-10555-001

dimensions.assessment: One-time property conveyance with permanent conditions requiring public use and potential federal reversion.
dimensions.evidence: if the property conveyed under subsection (a) ceases to be used... the property shall, at the discretion of the Secretary, revert to the United States.

missing_information: Exact monetary values for the conveyance costs and property appraisal are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs a one-time property conveyance of approximately one acre of federal Forest Service land to Perry County, Arkansas, for public purposes.
